title: Fix demos for IE11
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
Demos do not work on IE11 and the solution we provide is not good enough (using polyfill.io)

However a user offered us a solution: everything is detailed in this [post](https://discourse.algolia.com/t/no-search-result-with-ie11-solved/5391).

Let's fix that.
